# Clipper 6.4.2.2

Source: https://github.com/junmer/clipper-lib (npm `clipper-lib@6.4.2`).

`clipper.mjs` contains the original source and notices wrapped with a private
CommonJS-style `module` object and an ESM default export. It is served locally;
the application does not fetch dependencies from a CDN.

Used by `pen-path.js` to inset filled glyph outlines while retaining counters
and connected components. Boost Software License: `clipper-LICENSE.txt`.
